authority: Human asks to run next B3, diagnose and tune if it underperforms, and retain all outcomes
initial_protocol: Original archived FR-ST: SSC 0.918, unchanged 10-epoch TOF, unchanged 15-epoch detector, generated-validation p95.5
tuning_trigger: Completed original-protocol B3 F1 does not exceed historical Gen+GCAD F1 0.9617486338797814
tuning_family: Existing TransformerAutoencoder only; same covered-view-cv protocol used on US, fixed now before FR B3 results
selection: Mean generic-unseen-action proxy F1 across historical-normal and B3-normal training corpora; ties normal reconstruction loss and original-setting proximity
normal_validation: Exact-duplicate groups disjoint; validation actions retain training support; full/prefix/singleton views generated only from held-out parents
final_evaluation_policy: If triggered, lock one shared parameter setting, refit both arms, evaluate once, retain results even if lower; no choosing a second family by target F1
limitations: Historical test was already scored. Tuning outcome is exploratory. Multiple normal views are correlated, synthetic proxies are not true attack labels, and all formal status claims must preserve these limits.
